subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress supervised Gateway `update.run` managed-service handoffs, or remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies only?
rationale: The source change is narrow, but it changes the meaning of an existing environment kill-switch and the behavior of explicit operator/control-plane update requests on supervised installs.

options.title: Extend The Kill-Switch
options.body: Make supervised `update.run` return a clear skipped/refused response before creating a handoff when `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1`, and update docs/tests around that broader contract.

options.title: Document Auto-Only Scope
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` limited to configured `update.auto` applies and clarify that explicit `update.run` requests can still restart supervised Gateways.

options.title: Split A New Strict Knob
options.body: Leave the existing env var unchanged and design a separate explicit no-update-run policy for headless operators.

recommendation.title: Extend The Kill-Switch
recommendation.body: Make supervised `update.run` return a clear skipped/refused response before creating a handoff when `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1`, and update docs/tests around that broader contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway restart behavior, updater policy, and docs, and steipete is both the recent current-main area contributor and a foundational updater/restart-flow author.
